description: This file contains a test for a device emulation feature in a Playwright-based testing framework. It sets up a test case to verify that a specified device profile ('iPhone 15') is correctly applied during browser automation, and verifies the browser window dimensions in the page content.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines a test case named '--device should work' which runs an asynchronous function to set up and verify device emulation.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Provides assertion methods to verify the expectations about the test outcomes, such as page responses and content.
